quorum.kill_rule: any un-countered substantive objection kills the claim
refuted_claims: Wiring tripwire::chain into the event-log write path is the fix #416 asks for — REFUTED: the ticket offers either/or and asks for the smaller honest change; a chain without a trust root, verifier and gap policy would be a second claim outrunning behaviour. Withdrawn [A].

[UNKNOWN] should keep passing under --json so machine consumers see the state without a non-zero exit — REFUTED: Terraform -detailed-exitcode and Kani fail the run and put the detail in the payload; forjar now does both on every path.
quorum.divergence: the implementation lane fixed the three named defects; the review lane found the JSON payload still claimed SLSA, a stray clap attribute from the deletion, and a machine-isolation break the UNKNOWN fix introduced — all three taken and pinned.

systems: Terraform — plan -detailed-exitcode: 0 clean, 1 error, 2 changes; an undecided state never exits 0
Kani / cargo-verify — UNKNOWN (solver timeout, unsupported construct) is a hard failure, never UNREACHABLE
SLSA — a conformance level presupposes a signed, non-falsifiable attestation; an unsigned JSON is Level nothing
in-toto — a statement without a DSSE envelope is explicitly untrusted
crux.verdict: every surveyed system fails the run on an undecided obligation and refuses to call an unsigned statement conformant; prove is now at that bar and provenance says what it is.
